systemTitle: SMART E-COMMERCE MANAGEMENT SYSTEM USING MONGODB

customers.purpose: Core customer identity, KYC status, and basic demographic account details

fields.name: gender
fields.notes: Male / Female / Other / Prefer not to say

fields.name: dateOfBirth
fields.notes: Date of birth in YYYY-MM-DD format

fields.name: kycVerified
fields.notes: Indicates completion of Govt ID / Aadhaar verification

fields.name: tags
fields.notes: Customer segmentation & loyalty tags array for $in and $all operations

customer_profiles.purpose: Extended demographic, biographical, and lifestyle information for personalization

fields.name: bio
fields.example: Tech enthusiast and smart home gadget collector from Bengaluru

fields.name: annualIncomeRange
fields.notes: Income bracket in INR for marketing classification

fields.name: preferredLanguage
fields.notes: Preferred language: English, Hindi, Kannada, Tamil, etc.

addresses.purpose: Multiple physical delivery and billing addresses associated with customers

contacts.purpose: Primary and secondary emergency/communication contacts per customer

fields.name: contactValue
fields.notes: Phone number or email address value

fields.name: isPrimary
fields.notes: Is this the main contact point

preferences.purpose: Notification channels, privacy controls, UI themes, and platform settings

fields.name: emailNotifications
fields.notes: Consent to marketing and order emails

fields.name: preferredPaymentMethod
fields.notes: Default checkout method: UPI, CREDIT_CARD, NET_BANKING

login_history.purpose: Audit trail of customer session authentications, devices, IPs, and security events

wishlists.purpose: Saved items, target price points, and priority bookmarks for future purchase

fields.name: addedPrice
fields.notes: Price in INR when item was added to wishlist

fields.name: isPublic
fields.notes: Can this wishlist be shared via URL

loyalty_accounts.purpose: Tier levels, reward points balance, redemption history, and VIP perks

fields.name: annualSpendINR
fields.notes: Qualifying spend in INR this calendar year

fields.name: lastPointsActivityAt
fields.notes: Timestamp of latest earn or burn event

customer_support.purpose: Support tickets, disputes, inquiries, and resolution communications

fields.name: subject
fields.example: Shipment delayed beyond promised delivery date

fields.name: description
fields.example: Package ORD-10001 has been stuck at sorting center for 3 days.

fields.name: resolutionNotes
fields.example: Contacted Delhivery hub; expedited delivery scheduled for tomorrow morning.

customer_activity.purpose: Clickstream events, page hits, cart interactions, and search actions

fields.name: durationSeconds
fields.notes: Dwell time on the target page in seconds

fields.name: activityMetadata
fields.notes: Custom JSON payload with interaction telemetry

products.purpose: Master catalog containing base items, SKU identity, and core pricing

fields.name: tags
fields.notes: Product search & categorization tags array for $all, $elemMatch, and $unwind operations

categories.purpose: High-level department classification, tax codes, and navigation trees

fields.name: description
fields.example: Smartphones, laptops, audio systems, and consumer electronics

fields.name: isActive
fields.notes: Whether category is visible to shoppers

subcategories.purpose: Granular sub-department organization and fee structures

fields.name: description
fields.example: 5G flagships, budget phones, cases, and fast chargers

brands.purpose: Manufacturer and brand partner registries, origins, and corporate credentials

product_variants.purpose: Color, size, RAM/ROM capacity permutations with specific SKUs and price differentials

fields.name: priceAdjustmentINR
fields.notes: Price difference relative to base product

fields.name: isDefault
fields.notes: Default variant selection on product page

product_images.purpose: Product gallery assets, hero renders, thumbnails, and SEO alt texts

fields.name: altText
fields.example: OnePlus 12 5G Flowy Emerald front display view

fields.name: resolution
fields.notes: Width x Height dimensions in pixels

product_specs.purpose: Granular technical specifications and hardware parameters for faceted filtering

fields.name: specGroup
fields.notes: Category grouping: Processor, Camera, Battery, Display

product_discounts.purpose: Special product-level promotions, flash deals, and partner bank offers

fields.name: discountValue
fields.notes: Percentage (10) or flat amount in INR

fields.name: applicableBank
fields.notes: HDFC Bank, ICICI Bank, SBI Card, ALL

product_tags.purpose: Marketing labels, badges (Bestseller, 5G), and festive seasonal highlights

product_warranty.purpose: Manufacturer guarantee terms, coverage details, exclusions, and claim SLAs

fields.name: coverageDetails
fields.example: Covers internal hardware defects, motherboard, and battery replacement

fields.name: exclusions
fields.example: Physical drop damage, liquid ingress, unauthorized third-party repairs

fields.name: claimProcess
fields.example: Visit authorized brand service center with tax invoice

orders.purpose: Master sales transactions containing monetary totals, customer keys, and statuses

fields.name: totalItemCount
fields.notes: Total quantity of items in order

fields.name: subtotalAmountINR
fields.notes: Gross item price subtotal in INR

fields.name: totalAmountINR
fields.notes: Final net payable amount in INR

fields.name: orderStatus
fields.notes: PLACED, CONFIRMED, PROCESSING, SHIPPED, DELIVERED, CANCELLED, RETURNED

fields.name: orderTags
fields.notes: Order fulfillment tags array for $in and $elemMatch filtering

order_items.purpose: Itemized line entries linking orders to products, variants, quantities, and prices

fields.name: unitPriceINR
fields.notes: Unit selling price locked at checkout

fields.name: totalItemPriceINR
fields.notes: Final line amount inclusive of tax and discounts

order_status.purpose: Chronological status transition audit log with actor signatures and notifications

fields.name: remarks
fields.example: Payment verified via Razorpay gateway, order forwarded to warehouse

shipments.purpose: Logistics carrier dispatches, consignment weights, AWB numbers, and tracking

delivery_addresses.purpose: Snapshot of delivery destination address frozen at the time order was locked

returns.purpose: Customer return requests, inspection audits, pickup tracking, and reasons

fields.name: returnStatus
fields.notes: REQUESTED, APPROVED, PICKUP_SCHEDULED, PICKED_UP, INSPECTED, REJECTED

fields.name: inspectionRemarks
fields.example: Verified hardware display issue reported by customer

refunds.purpose: Reversals, payment reimbursements, banking references, and payout settlements

coupons.purpose: Promotional vouchers, minimum cart thresholds, redemption caps, and validity

fields.name: maxDiscountLimitINR
fields.notes: Cap on total discount in INR

order_tracking.purpose: Granular GPS checkpoint pings, transit hubs, and rider telemetry

cancellations.purpose: Pre-dispatch or transit cancellations, fees, and reasons

fields.name: detailedReason
fields.example: Found lower price on another seller platform

inventory.purpose: Current on-hand stock quantities, reserved allocations, and safety reorder levels

fields.name: quantityReserved
fields.notes: Allocated to in-flight orders awaiting dispatch

fields.name: unitCostINR
fields.notes: Procurement cost per unit in INR

warehouses.purpose: Fulfillment center locations, square footage, manager details, and operating status

fields.name: geoCoordinates
fields.notes: Nested geographic coordinates object for spatial and dot-notation querying

suppliers.purpose: Vendor master records, GSTIN identification, credit terms, and performance ratings

stock_movements.purpose: Inbound, outbound, and inter-warehouse physical stock transfer ledger

fields.name: reason
fields.example: Stock balancing for upcoming festival sale

purchase_orders.purpose: B2B procurement contracts issued to suppliers with monetary totals and SLAs

fields.name: notes
fields.example: Q1 bulk replenishment for flagship smartphones

purchase_items.purpose: Itemized line items within procurement POs with unit costs and quality inspection

restock_requests.purpose: Automated or manual stock replenishment triggers, urgency levels, and workflows

fields.name: currentStockLevel
fields.notes: Stock level when restock was triggered

fields.name: requestedQuantity
fields.notes: Units needed to restore safety buffer

damaged_stock.purpose: Damaged inventory tracking, loss estimations, insurance claims, and write-offs

fields.name: estimatedLossINR
fields.notes: Total book cost loss in INR

warehouse_staff.purpose: Personnel assignments, shift schedules, roles, and emergency contact registries

inventory_alerts.purpose: Automated threshold alerts, stock depletion warnings, and operational notifications

fields.name: message
fields.example: Stock level for OnePlus 12 5G (Flowy Emerald) is 12 units, below safety threshold 25

fields.name: autoRestockTriggered
fields.notes: Whether automatic purchase order was generated

payment_db.domain: Payment Processing, Invoicing, Taxes & Wallet Balances

payments.purpose: Master payment transaction records, gateway charges, and settlement states

fields.name: paymentMethodType
fields.notes: UPI, CREDIT_CARD, DEBIT_CARD, NET_BANKING, WALLET, COD

transactions.purpose: Detailed bank ledger charges, captures, reversals, and settlement batches

invoices.purpose: Legal GST tax invoices, CGST/SGST/IGST breakdowns, and PDF URLs

fields.name: totalInvoiceAmountINR
fields.notes: Final invoice sum inclusive of GST

payment_methods.purpose: RBI-compliant tokenized cards, UPI VPA handles, and saved customer instruments

fields.name: providerName
fields.notes: Google Pay, PhonePe, HDFC Visa, ICICI NetBanking

fields.name: maskedAccountNumber
fields.notes: Masked card number or UPI handle

fields.name: cardHolderName
fields.notes: Name embossed on card / bank account

refund_transactions.purpose: Banking refund disbursements, payment gateway reversal tokens, and speed tiers

tax_records.purpose: Statutory GSTR compliance, fiscal quarter reporting, and HSN/SAC classifications

fields.name: taxRecordId
fields.notes: Unique statutory tax audit entry identifier

fields.name: taxQuarter
fields.notes: Fiscal quarter: Q1, Q2, Q3, Q4

wallets.purpose: Stored-value digital balances, instant cashback pools, and daily spend limits

fields.name: currentBalanceINR
fields.notes: Liquid spendable wallet funds in INR

offers.purpose: Instant banking partnership cashback campaigns, credit card discounts, and validity

fields.name: description
fields.example: Get flat 10% instant discount up to ₹2000 on HDFC Bank Credit Cards

fields.name: bankPartner
fields.notes: HDFC Bank, ICICI Bank, SBI Card, Axis Bank

financial_summary.purpose: Periodic aggregate GMV, net revenue, refunds, gateway commissions, and success ratios

fields.name: grossMerchandiseValueINR
fields.notes: Total GMV in INR before cancellations

payment_failures.purpose: Error diagnosis, bank failure codes, device metadata, and cart recovery tracking

fields.name: errorDescription
fields.example: Issuer bank server timed out during 3D-Secure OTP verification

analytics_db.domain: Reviews, Customer Metrics, Sales Aggregates & Recommendations

reviews.purpose: Customer written reviews, verified purchase verification, moderation status, and votes

fields.name: reviewBody
fields.example: The Snapdragon 8 Gen 3 handles everything seamlessly. Battery lasts over a day easily.

ratings.purpose: Multi-dimensional rating breakdown (battery, camera, build quality, value for money)

product_feedback.purpose: NLP sentiment analysis scores, bug reports, and packaging feedback tickets

fields.name: sentimentScore
fields.notes: NLP sentiment polar score (-1.0 negative to +1.0 positive)

fields.name: feedbackText
fields.example: Delivery box was slightly scuffed on corner, but internal phone packaging was intact.

fields.name: actionTaken
fields.example: Flagged packaging feedback to BlueDart hub

sales_daily.purpose: Daily rolled-up sales, order volumes, discount totals, and average order values

fields.name: totalRevenueINR
fields.notes: Total gross revenue generated in INR

sales_monthly.purpose: Monthly business performance metrics, return percentages, and top products

fields.name: netSalesINR
fields.notes: Net sales after discounts and refunds

customer_metrics.purpose: RFM scores (Recency, Frequency, Monetary), lifetime spend, and churn probability

product_metrics.purpose: Conversion funnels, pageviews, cart adds, inventory turnover, and return rates

category_metrics.purpose: Category revenue contribution shares, month-on-month growth, and ASP

fields.name: revenueContributionPercentage
fields.notes: Category percentage share of company GMV

search_history.purpose: Customer search queries, click-through conversions, search latency, and zero-result audits

fields.name: searchQuery
fields.notes: Raw text query typed by shopper

fields.name: userConverted
fields.notes: Whether search led to cart add/checkout

recommendations.purpose: ML personalized recommendation carousels, algorithmic scoring, impressions, and CTR

fields.name: rankPosition
fields.notes: Slot position in frontend carousel (1 = first)
